summary: Match verification layers to impact and uncertainty, then separate proven behavior from assumptions and acceptance gaps.

outcomes: Map material risks to static, automated, live, independent, or user verification.
Separate verified behavior from plans, assumptions, and unverified acceptance.

scenarios.title: Verify a risky implementation
scenarios.prompt: Use the verify-work-proportionally skill to choose and run appropriate checks for this cross-cutting implementation.
scenarios.outcome: Each material risk has an observable check and the final report states exact verified coverage.

scenarios.title: Decide whether user approval is needed
scenarios.prompt: Use the verify-work-proportionally skill to determine which remaining acceptance points require the user's judgment.
scenarios.outcome: Only irreducible product, taste, privacy, or authorization decisions are returned to the user.
